_about: Wording a person has approved. 'pins' puts votes at the top of the home page for 90 days. 'votes' sets the name, outcome and one-line explanation for a vote, and always wins over AI or automatic wording.

2026-317.name: Hegseth impeachment
2026-317.plain: The House voted to send the impeachment of the Defense Secretary to a committee instead of voting on it. One Republican sided with Democrats to keep it alive.

2026-320.name: Veterans' disability pay
2026-320.plain: The House pulled a bill out of committee that would let veterans with combat-related disabilities collect both disability and retirement pay.

2026-307.name: Iran war powers
2026-307.plain: The House directed the President to remove U.S. armed forces from hostilities with Iran.
